configurations.name: adaptx-backend
runtimeArgs: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); import uvicorn; uvicorn.run('adaptx.api.app:create_app', factory=True, host='127.0.0.1', port=8000, log_level='warning')

configurations.name: adaptx-backend-carla
runtimeArgs: import os, sys; os.environ.setdefault('ADAPTX_CARLA__ENABLED', 'true'); os.environ.setdefault('ADAPTX_CARLA__HOST', '127.0.0.1'); os.environ.setdefault('ADAPTX_CARLA__EGO_SPAWN_INDEX', '1'); os.environ.setdefault('ADAPTX_LIDAR__GROUND_ENABLED', 'true'); sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); import uvicorn; uvicorn.run('adaptx.api.app:create_app', factory=True, host='127.0.0.1', port=8000, log_level='warning')
